def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def remove_quotes(val):
    """Helper that removes surrounding quotes from strings."""
    if val is None:
        return
    if val[0] in ('"', "'", '`') and val[0] == val[-1]:
        val = val[1:-1]
    return val

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def remove_quotes(val):
    """Helper that removes surrounding quotes from strings."""
    if val is None:

    if val[0] in ('"', "'", '`') and val[0] == val[-1]:

class TestFunction:
    def _make_function(self, params):
        fname = Token(T.Name, 'func')
        open_ = Token(T.Punctuation, '(')
        close = Token(T.Punctuation, ')')
        par = Parenthesis([open_] + params + [close])
        return Function([fname, par])

    def test_get_parameters_simple(self):
        lit = Token(T.Literal.Number.Integer, 1)
        f = self._make_function([lit])
        assert f.get_parameters() == [lit]

    def test_get_parameters_identifier(self):
        idn = ident(Token(T.Name, 'x'))
        f = self._make_function([idn])
        assert f.get_parameters() == [idn]

        a = ident(Token(T.Name, 'a'))
        comma = Token(T.Punctuation, ',')
        b = ident(Token(T.Name, 'b'))
        il = IdentifierList([a, comma, b])
        f = self._make_function([il])
        params = f.get_parameters()
        assert params == [a, b]

    def test_get_window_none(self):
        idn = ident(Token(T.Name, 'x'))
        f = self._make_function([idn])
        assert f.get_window() is None

    def test_get_window(self):
        fname = Token(T.Name, 'func')
        par = Parenthesis([Token(T.Punctuation, '('),
                           ident(Token(T.Name, 'x')),
                           Token(T.Punctuation, ')')])
        inner = Token(T.Name, 'win')
        over = Over([Token(T.Keyword, 'OVER'), inner])
        f = Function([fname, par, over])
        assert f.get_window() is inner

    def test_function_alias(self):
        fname = Token(T.Name, 'func')

                           Token(T.Punctuation, ')')])
        ws = Token(T.Whitespace, ' ')
        alias = Token(T.Name, 'aliased')
        f = Function([fname, par, ws, alias])
        assert f.get_alias() == 'aliased'

    def test_function_real_name(self):
        fname = Token(T.Name, 'func')
        par = Parenthesis([Token(T.Punctuation, '('),
                           Token(T.Punctuation, ')')])
        f = Function([fname, par])
        assert f.get_real_name() == 'func'

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

class TestCase:
    def test_get_cases_simple(self):
        case = Case([
            Token(T.Keyword, 'CASE'),
            Token(T.Name, 'x'),
            Token(T.Keyword, 'WHEN'),
            Token(T.Name, 'cond'),
            Token(T.Keyword, 'THEN'),
            Token(T.Name, 'val'),
            Token(T.Keyword, 'END'),
        ])
        cases = case.get_cases()
        # First bare segment is (x, []) then WHEN gives (cond, val)
        assert len(cases) == 2
        assert [t.value for t in cases[0][0]] == ['x']
        assert cases[0][1] == []
        assert [t.value for t in cases[1][0]] == ['cond']
        assert [t.value for t in cases[1][1]] == ['val']

    def test_get_cases_else(self):
        case = Case([
            Token(T.Keyword, 'CASE'),
            Token(T.Keyword, 'WHEN'),
            Token(T.Name, 'cond'),
            Token(T.Keyword, 'THEN'),
            Token(T.Name, 'val'),
            Token(T.Keyword, 'ELSE'),
            Token(T.Name, 'other'),
            Token(T.Keyword, 'END'),
        ])
        cases = case.get_cases()
        assert len(cases) == 2
        assert cases[0][0][0].value == 'cond'
        assert cases[0][1][0].value == 'val'
        assert cases[1][0] is None
        assert cases[1][1][0].value == 'other'

            Token(T.Keyword, 'THEN'),
            Token(T.Name, 'v'),
            Token(T.Keyword, 'END'),

        cases = case.get_cases(skip_ws=True)
        assert len(cases) == 1
        assert cases[0][0] == []

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

    if val is None:

    if val[0] in ('"', "'", '`') and val[0] == val[-1]:

    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:

    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def imt(token, i=None, m=None, t=None):
    """Helper function to simplify comparisons Instance, Match and TokenType
    :param token:
    :param i: Class or Tuple/List of Classes
    :param m: Tuple of TokenType & Value. Can be list of Tuple for multiple
    :param t: TokenType or Tuple/List of TokenTypes
    :return:  bool
    """
    if token is None:
        return False
    if i and isinstance(token, i):
        return True
    if m:
        if isinstance(m, list):
            if any(token.match(*pattern) for pattern in m):
                return True
        elif token.match(*m):
            return True
    if t:
        if isinstance(t, list):
            if any(token.ttype in ttype for ttype in t):
                return True
        elif token.ttype in t:
            return True
    return False

def remove_quotes(val):
    """Helper that removes surrounding quotes from strings."""
    if val is None:
        return
    if val[0] in ('"', "'", '`') and val[0] == val[-1]:
        val = val[1:-1]
    return val
